about.description: Lofty AI is a marketplace for fractional ownership in individual rental properties, where each listing is paired with a structured legal wrapper and property documentation that investors can review. The experience is designed around property-level transparency, including access to deeds, closing documents, and operating agreements, so users can evaluate each property’s backing and terms directly.
about.registryInfo: Lofty Ai, Inc. – Delaware corporation headquartered in Los Angeles, California, as described in the California DFPI consent order dated 14 November 2022 regarding Lofty Ai, Inc.'s tokenized real estate offerings.
